test_title: PYST 6: SSC CGL - Reasoning (Held On : 12 April 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: There are six members, P, Q, R, S, T and U, in a family. T is the brother of P’s husband. U is the mother of T. Q is the daughter of S and P and the granddaughter of R. How is R related to T?
solution:
By using the symbols in the table given below, we can draw the following family tree:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7d2fbc5d46351fc61d37b2496dc425981859472f79188553d45aaaad0ce88e32.png] 

Six members - **P, Q, R, S, T and U** in a family. 

1. T is the brother of P’s husband. 

2. U is the mother of T. 

3. Q is the daughter of S and P and the granddaughter of R. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d9ca7495a0c7b5dac7af8ff9aa46887eda57f44e1692ee6d3e0543b3b9a1921c.png] 

Clearly, R is father of T.

Hence, ‘**Father**’ is the correct answer.
